This marketplace is open by construction:"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" **any repo tagged `topic:dsh-plugin` is discoverable the moment it is pushed** — no submission, no "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"approval queue. To keep that openness usable:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Automatic verification** — every search result's `package.json` is fetched (jsDelivr/raw dual-so"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"urce CDN, no API quota) and checked for the official `dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` manifest. Verified "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"plugins get a green badge; the default "verified only" view filters out ~73% of topic noise (empty r"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"epos and unrelated projects riding the tag).
- **Browse-time compatibility badges** — each card is a"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"lso statically scanned against your profile before you click anything: declared conflicts, exclusive"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" groups, loader-id collisions (from the repo's patch file), rows the candidate's patch would switch "},{"id":"p8s7","text":"off or reconfigure in the profile you already run, host-module shadowing, and peer/Node/OS ranges. C"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ards show 适配 / 有风险 / 冲突 / 适配未知 accordingly — advisory only; the install preflight remains the enforc"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ing gate.
- **Anti-squatting** — an install prefers the npm tarball only when the registry entry's `"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"repository` URL points back to the same GitHub repo; anything else falls back to the explicit `githu"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"b:` spec.

- **Update management** — installed plugins are compared against th"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"e registry `latest`; one-click update per plugin.
